messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads-up — Sparrow's embed onboarding spiked token burn ~3x overnight, landed on our daily spend alert. noticed mostly embedding calls from the search pipeline.
Owen (FinOps): saw the billing-bot alert, putting a temporary throttle on their key. sending numbers in a sec. :eyes:
billing-bot: ALERT: account=sparrow, metric=daily_spend, value=4.1x expected, threshold=2.0x. triggered=2026-03-22T21:12:03Z
Raj (AE): ugh, their renewal is Jun 1. this is the kind of surprise that causes friction. can we get a short remediation plan before QBR?
Linh (OnboardEng): digging in the onboarding logs now. early signal: they switched to dense-embedding mode and set batch_size=1 for realtime writes. lots of short requests.
Casey (Product): if it's many small writes we should recommend batching + async ingestion. can we propose a concrete config change they can flip?
Maya (CSM): proposal: (1) temporary rate cap to stop runaway cost, (2) enable batching on their client (example below), (3) suggest int8 quantized model variant for embeddings as a cheaper option, (4) schedule enablement call with Sparrow ops tomorrow.
Owen (FinOps): agree. temporary rate cap = 50 rps for embeddings route for 24h. also offering to allocate $5k in retainer credit to smooth QBR conversation? need approval from finance.
Linh (OnboardEng): batching snippet to share:

```
# pseudo-client
queue.append(record)
if len(queue) >= 128 or time_since_flush > 500ms:
  send_batch(queue)
```

Linh (OnboardEng): also setting their Dedicated pooling to allow 2x KV cache size for embeddings to reduce repeated recompute.
Raj (AE): retainer credit sounds good — helps tone down renewal risk. I'll own the ask.
Casey (Product): small config tweak: reduce max_context for embedding requests to 512 for non-critical indexing jobs; combine with prefix caching. That should reduce per-request tokens.
Maya (CSM): action items: Linh to post exact client patch & rollout steps; Owen to apply temporary throttle and chase finance for credit; Raj to prep renewal note for QBR with mitigation + credits; Casey to write short blurb on quantized embedding variant and expected per-token savings.
Linh (OnboardEng): posting patch now in Sparrow's onboarding repo: https://git.internal/sparrow/onboard/patch-embed-batch (internal). snippet included in handout.
Owen (FinOps): throttle applied at 21:30 UTC. billing-bot will quiet once daily spend <2x.
Maya (CSM): scheduling 30m enablement tomorrow 15:00 PT — will invite Sparrow ops + dev + Raj + Linh + Owen. please add any docs to the meeting thread.
Raj (AE): I'll draft the QBR talking points: one-slide summary (what happened, immediate mitigation, long-term recommendations, credit ask).
Casey (Product): quick note for slide: expected unit cost reduction: batching -> ~35% savings; quantized embeddings -> ~45% CPU/GPU cost delta on inference. numbers conservative.
Maya (CSM): capturing customer feedback: Sparrow mentioned urgency to keep search freshness under 5s. we need to balance latency vs cost in the enablement call.
Linh (OnboardEng): agreed — will bring a canary plan: 10% rollout of batching + metric dashboard (latency, token per request, cost per minute).
Owen (FinOps): follow-up: tagging for internal runway risk: renewal_risk=medium until post-call. will update account health dashboard.
Maya (CSM): perfect. thanks team. I'll ping the meeting invite and attach the patch + slide draft before EOD. :thumbsup:
